title: Profile card with experience meter and social row (bar layout vs ring layout)
contains_third_party_content: 3D-style cartoon avatar; cloud photo header; social platform icons (Instagram, X, Threads).

observed.layout: Two cards side by side. Left: cloud-photo header with a 'Follow +' pill at top-right, circular avatar overlapping with a thin outline, an 'exp.' label with a segmented gradient bar fading to empty ticks, name 'Noah Thompson', two-line bio, three stat columns with dividers (72.9K Likes, 828 Posts, 342.9K Views), and a footer row of three equal social-icon cells. Right: same content centered; the avatar has a rainbow progress ring, the top-right button is a '+' circle, stats sit in an inset rounded panel, and social icons are bare icons centered below.
observed.hierarchy: Name, then stat numbers, then bio.
observed.typography: Neutral grotesk; medium name, bold stat numbers, light-grey bio. Unconfirmed.
observed.iconography: Simple line icons for socials; plus icon.
observed.materials: Soft white cards with a gentle shadow; photographic header.

interpretation.aesthetic: Clean, friendly profile card; the experience metric adds a game-like touch.
implementation_notes: Segmented bar: repeated tick elements or a mask over a gradient.
Ring: conic-gradient or SVG stroke around the avatar.
Stat columns: three-column grid with dividers; inset-panel variant uses a tinted background.

concept_work.essence: One profile, two ways to encode a level metric (bar or ring).
what_makes_it_work: Stats are labeled and easy to scan.
Equal social cells give a tidy footer.
Both layouts keep the same content.
gaps_to_make_it_work: The 'exp.' meter has no value or explanation.
The ring has no label, so it can read as decoration.
Bio and stat labels measure about 4.0-4.9:1, near the 4.5:1 threshold.
'Follow +' and '+' differ in meaning between variants.

components.name: Avatar with experience encoding
components.role: identity plus a level metric (bar or ring)

shared_tokens: single gradient reserved for the metric
links: The experience bar and the avatar ring encode the same metric, so the avatar and the metric are linked.
Stats and social row sit in a consistent footer region in both layouts.

pattern.name: Same data, two encodings (bar vs avatar ring)
use_when: Profiles that show a level, progress or reputation metric
avoid_when: The metric means nothing to viewers
must_preserve: A label or tooltip for the metric
adaptation_examples: Learning app: ring shows course progress.
Creator platform: bar shows reputation level.
failure_modes: Gradient meter without a numeric value

lessons: Give every novel metric a label or legend.
Show the same data in two encodings to compare which communicates better.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
palette: experience bar and avatar ring (purple, green, yellow, orange); not sampled precisely
avatar skin and bag tones (saturated median)
measured.color_roles: Neutral white cards; color only in the avatar and the experience meter.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: A creator profile with the key signals up front.
Clean hierarchy with a pleasant photographic header.
Stat trios are unambiguous and conventionally structured.
Follow is clear, but the metric is unexplained and no followed state is shown.
Both layouts share content, spacing and radii, though the metric meaning is unclear.
An experience meter and an alternative ring encoding add something beyond a stock profile card.

Scored on conservative values: primary text min 15.3:1; secondary text min 3.99:1; icon min 16.56:1; non-color state cue: True. Using best-estimate values the score would be 5; the measurement is within error of a threshold.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
